title.narrative: 2.3. Strengthened children's access to justice and capacity of professionals to enhance diversion, alternative measures,restorative justice and child friendly proceeding.

description.narrative: The Juvenile Justice National Strategic Plan was endorsed by the National Justice Steering Committee and informed by a justice assessment; diversionary measures for children in contact with the law were strengthened, and related child-friendly Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) were developed. UNICEF joined the UNDP/UN Women justice and security programme | Status:On-track | As-of Date:31/12/2017

title.narrative: Juvenile protection law approved

actual.value: 2017:Fully achieved: The Juvenile Protection law was officially endorsed by presidential decree. UNICEF and the MOSD subsequently developed a road map for its implementation, which was reworked into the National Strategic Plan and Implementation Framework for Juvenile protection (2016-2019)

title.narrative: Model related to alternative to detention for children in conflict with the law developed

actual.value: 2017:Partially achieved: A network of 70 organisations providing alternatives to detention was established in the WB. The mapping of the 70 organizations has been adopted and launched by MOSD. TDH and DCI have drafted guidelines for mediation of children in contact in the law. It is a long term object
